news.title: Metro Atlanta CEO accused of faking wealth to score $24 million bank loan
news.summary: A former Georgia manufacturing executive is facing fraud charges after prosecutors say he used forged documents and fake financial statements to secure a $24 million loan.

news.title: Suspect facing arson charges taken into custody after barricaded SWAT operation in Cobb County
news.summary: Cobb County Police said the suspect was taken into custody just after noon Tuesday following an operation in a Mableton neighborhood.

news.title: Video shows Atlanta police rescue 2 young girls from trailer
news.summary: Atlanta police released video showing officers rescuing two young sisters from a trailer after they were reported missing over the weekend.

news.title: Warrants: Babysitter accused of kidnapping young Atlanta sisters met their mom in pregnancy Facebook group, was hiding girls in hot tow trailer
news.summary: The girls, 4-year-old Zola Cooper and her sister, 11-month-old Norah Cooper, were the subject of an Amber Alert on Monday.

news.title: Former Cartersville business owner arraigned on fraud charges
news.summary: A former Cartersville manufacturing business owner faces federal bank and wire fraud charges after allegedly defrauding First Financial Bank out of more than $20 million through forged documents.

news.title: New details about woman accused of kidnapping Atlanta sisters
news.summary: A woman accused of kidnapping two young sisters in Atlanta waived her initial court appearance Tuesday as prosecutors in Alabama moved to revoke her bond in a separate kidnapping case.

news.title: Alicia Brown sues Fulton sheriff over kidnapping warrant arrest
news.summary: Alicia Brown is suing Fulton County Sheriff Patrick Labat and the Fulton County Sheriff's Office, alleging an erroneous kidnapping warrant led to her July arrest.

news.title: Fight at DeKalb County school leads to large police response
news.summary: A heavy emergency response descended on Eagle Woods Academy on Tuesday morning after a student fight led to pepper spray being discharged.

news.title: Mother's boyfriend now indicted on multiple murder counts, other charges after 2-year-old's body found in Marietta
news.summary: 23-year-old Darian Keith was previously charged with two felony charges of concealing a death and making false statements.

news.title: Former South Fulton officer acquitted on all charges in relation to 2018 on-duty crash
news.summary: Former Officer Deonte Walker was found not guilty by a Fulton County jury in the case on Monday.

news.title: Oxford man charged in fatal Conyers hit-and-run crash
news.summary: A 52-year-old man faces a vehicular homicide charge after Flock license plate readers helped law enforcement track down a suspect in a fatal Conyers hit-and-run within 12 hours.

news.title: Conyers Police make arrest in hit-and-run that killed 43-year-old woman
news.summary: The Conyers Police Department said Tuesday morning that a 52-year-old man has been charged with homicide by vehicle.

news.title: Atlanta police officer out of hospital after being shot in arm responding to mental health crisis; 1 in custody
news.summary: Mayor Andre Dickens and Police Chief Darin Schierbaum gave details on the situation in an update outside Grady Hospital on Monday morning.

news.title: Canton shooting arrest: Man charged after wife wounded, adult children flee
news.summary: A 42-year-old man was arrested after allegedly shooting his wife in their Canton home early Saturday morning.

news.title: Domestic-related shooting leaves 1 dead at Gwinnett County townhome complex, police say
Georgia man accused of running $165 million crypto Ponzi scheme, arrested in Fiji
news.summary: The U.S. Attorney's Office in Atlanta said Monday that Edward Zimbardi will face wire fraud and money laundering charges.

news.title: Woman fights back sexual assault attempt near downtown Senoia, police say
news.summary: Police in Senoia are asking for help if anyone saw a suspicious man or anything else odd in the area on Sunday night after a woman reported an attempted assault.
